verdict.reason: The required interface is clearly defined by the test failure and the code changes. A solver can understand the intended functionality and implement the `specfunc` method to satisfy the tests.

required_interface.name: specfunc
required_interface.description: classmethod to create a Partial specfunc that takes a subspec argument.

verdict.statement: When constructing glom specifications, it is desirable to use existing functions or specifications as building blocks. Currently, the `Partial` class, used for creating specfuncs, does not support being used directly as a specfunc that takes a subspec argument. This prevents users from easily composing complex specifications by passing a subspec to a `Partial` instance. The ability to create a `Partial` specfunc that accepts a subspec is needed.
verdict.title: Add specfunc class method to Partial
